description: Ania Studio makes YouTuber-style videos about the user’s app, narrated by their own Ania avatar. A project is the series (brand, avatar, voice); each episode is one video with an Ania Script (titulo + cenas). Creates a project (the series) for one app. Needs an avatar from the user’s own library (my_avatars: created, bought or free) and a voice from studio_listar_vozes. Free; agree on name, colour and voice with the user first.

apresentador_nome.description: Presenter's name (defaults to the app name).

descricao.description: What the app does (optional, not spoken).

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

nome.description: App / series name shown in the vignette.

slogan.description: One-line slogan for the opening vignette (optional).

slug.description: Short id for the project, kebab-case (e.g. 'my-app').

name: studio_criar_projeto
title: Studio: create a project
